parameters.representative: largest sum of confidence; greedily attach non-overlapping adjacent fragments by geometry
parameters.reid: compare original MASA IDs before/after first observed query-visibility gap; no ID merging for identity decision

coverage_definition: rule returns an answer; unsupported/unobserved events abstain; illegal numerical 0/1 remain covered but incorrect and illegal
numerical_legality: canonical rule answer in {2,3,4,5 or more}; also report all-300 and covered-only denominators
